name: company-context
description: Shared engineering conventions for work on this codebase. Reference material, not instructions.
rules: Server code is CommonJS only; frontend code is ES modules bundled by Vite.
Do not add npm dependencies without explicit instruction.
Prefer early returns and guard clauses over else branches.
Keep pure logic in a core module and IO in a thin shell around it.
No em dash, en dash, ellipsis character, or emoji anywhere in source, tests, docs, or commits.
Run npm test before calling a change complete.
